test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b380f269ba1252907a41a2271a2d5aa202d8a0b17b06f54204cdbcabc2c4500.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04014ca83afe2bd8d137c3c78f28d9fc71f97e177b521a856cd388f3c1919c90.png] 

(14 + 10) = (4 × 6) 

24 = 24

And,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6c958fbc969e459b1deaa6f7557edb647027113c450848e9d2084cbe3f78203.png] 

(9 + 6) = (3 × 5) 

15 = 15

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50bf8e8824acd9de79a14a4c70c305d519d2cca8c87fc73d089a682af9db83ca.png] 

(13 + ?) = (5 × 6) 

? = 30 - 13

**? = 17**

Hence, **"Option 2" **is the correct answer.
